modelDescription: The X-Bolt 2 Speed Carbon Fiber SR. Features Vari-Tech composite stock adjustable for length of pull, comb height and grip angle for a personalized fit to the rifle; redesigned receiver and bolt; lightweight carbon fiber wrapped stainless steel barrel with threaded muzzle; Recoil Hawg muzzle brake reduces felt recoil up to 76% and a Tungsten Cerakote finish.
